questions.question: When Jesus was on the cross, darkness covered only the place where He was crucified. True or false?
When Jesus cried out "Eli, Eli" on the cross, whom did some of the people standing there say He was calling?
When Jesus died and the tombs broke open, what happened to the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep?
After Jesus died, what did the centurion and the men guarding Him with him say when they saw the earthquake?

answers.text: Truly this was the Son of God
Truly this was a great prophet
Truly this was the King of Israel
